tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the user's recent YADL projects (id, name, type, template).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a labeling project. type is boxes, polygons, or keypoints. For keypoints, pass template hand|pose|face (default hand). Does not upload files.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a project studio by id or exact name.

tools.name: prepare_media_upload
tools.description: Prepare media upload for an existing project (images, video, or zip). Sets the upload UI for project_id, optional video frame_interval, and aims the Select files control. Does not upload or submit — computer use must click Select files, choose files, then click Upload.

project_id.description: Project id from create_project or list_projects

frame_interval.description: Seconds between video frames (0.1–5). Applied when Upload runs if a video was selected.
